# Jaywalker Lodge

> > Jaywalker Lodge is a men's residential addiction treatment center located in Carbondale, Colorado, in the scenic Roaring Fork Valley.

Jaywalker provides comprehensive rehabilitation services in a mountain community setting near Aspen, Basalt, and Glenwood Springs. The facility serves clients from across Colorado and beyond, with convenient access from regional airports including Eagle-Vail, Aspen, and Denver.

## Key Topics

- Jaywalker Lodge
- Men's addiction treatment

## Admissions & Visiting Information

- [Planning on Visiting Jaywalker?](https://www.jaywalkerlodge.com/admissions/visiting/): Comprehensive visitor guide including lodging recommendations (Cactus Vacation Rentals, Comfort Inn & Suites, Courtyard by Marriott, Element Hotel, Hoffman Hotel), transportation options, and information about visiting the Carbondale facility in the Roaring Fork Valley near Aspen and Glenwood Springs
